posts.title: Welcome to the agent war: MAD for Silicon
posts.description: The race to build increasingly capable AI agents looks a lot like a new Cold War, complete with resource competition, public anxiety, and the growing need for international agreements.

posts.title: Using GoToSocial as the Social Layer for Your Apps
posts.description: How GoToSocial can provide identity, federation, and social features inside existing applications without requiring users to create and manage another account.

posts.title: LinuxFest Northwest 2026: Beer, Badges, and the Spirit of the PNW
posts.description: Three months after speaking at FOSDEM in Brussels, I brought my family to LinuxFest Northwest in Bellingham, WA. What I found was a college town bursting with craft beer, open-source energy, and one of my personal heroes.
